title: Cambridge IELTS 13 Test 4 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The plans below show the layout of a university's sports centre now, and how it will look after redevelopment.
scenario: The plans compare the present layout of a university sports centre with its future layout after redevelopment.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: UNIVERSITY SPORTS CENTRE
notes: The present plan shows a central 25m pool, with a changing room to the west, seating to the east, a gym to the north and reception at the southern entrance.
Outdoor courts are shown on both the west and east sides of the present sports centre.
The future plan encloses and expands the site. The 25m pool, central changing room, seating, gym, reception and southern entrance remain visible.
The future western side contains a leisure pool, a changing room and a sports shop.
The future eastern side contains a sports hall, two dance studios, a changing room and a café.
Compass symbols show north at the top, east to the right, south at the bottom and west to the left.
